d:
Akane tendo meets Shinnosuke in a Ranma ½ OVA; he is her first crush. In this version, she gives in to her desires and offers herself to Shinnosuke.
In my Ranma parodies, I like to imagine the characters having sex with their suitors or enemies from the manga, rather than with characters who have nothing to do with the story. The images are taken from an AI-generated video on Grok.
